title: Sales orders
emptyHint: Sales orders are created automatically when a customer accepts a quotation.
confirmDescription: Confirm this sales order and create its production order?
confirmedBanner: Sales order confirmed — production order created.
searchPlaceholder: Search by factory #, dealer #, project, or customer
holdDescription: Put this sales order on hold? You can optionally add a reason.
cancelDescription: Cancel this sales order? Related open production orders will also be cancelled.
mfgCostSubtitle: From finalized RAW usage (Piece 5) — separate from catalog BOM estimate
sectionPreProductionHint: Confirmed orders waiting to start on the floor
sectionDoneHint: Ready for delivery, delivered, or completed

orderSetup.title: Production setup
orderSetup.shortageNote: Shortage does not block release — the order may wait for materials after release.
orderSetup.noLines: No production-required lines on this sales order.
orderSetup.reviewReleaseHint: Mark ready when every line is complete, then release to create production orders.
orderSetup.markedReady: Production setup marked ready for release.
orderSetup.releaseConfirmDescription: This creates production orders from the reviewed setup. Scheduling is skipped — assign workers next.
orderSetup.releaseShortageWarning: Some materials are short; the sales order may become waiting for materials.
orderSetup.releasedWorkerRequired: Production released. Worker assignment is required before floor work can start.
orderSetup.workerAssignmentHint: Production orders were created without a schedule. Assign workers on the production board.
orderSetup.materialsEmpty: Add materials for this line, or seed from the catalog product.
orderSetup.confirmWorkflow: Confirm this workflow path for the factory
orderSetup.stagesPeopleHint: Each line becomes a factory order. Assign a worker per stage from their day plan; the factory floor takes over once work starts.
orderSetup.planStagesHint: Creates draft factory orders for these lines so you can assign workers before release.
orderSetup.surfaceHint: Prepare for production decides what and how (workflow, materials, notes, people). The factory floor runs it (start, tasks, WIP, quality).
orderSetup.noStagesYet: Choose and confirm a workflow first.

cancelImpact.sheetHint: Review what cancel will stop and what stays on the books.
cancelImpact.useReturnsBody: This order is already shipped or delivered. Cancel is blocked — open a return request.
cancelImpact.severityBody: Production work and inventory are involved. Review every impact line before confirming.
cancelImpact.notePlaceholder: Add context for the factory and finance teams
cancelImpact.financialAttentionBannerBody: Cancel does not refund or void invoices/payments. Resolve money separately.

desk.emptyFilteredBody: Loosen a filter or clear the search to see the rest.
